minutes.headline: Select Board approved a 30% water-rate increase under the Fitchburg intermunicipal agreement.
minutes.summary: The Select Board took two substantive votes -- entering executive session over firefighters' collective bargaining, and a 30% water rate increase tied to the Fitchburg intermunicipal agreement -- and spent most of the meeting line-editing its appointment policy and reviewing a draft special event license policy. Committee reports covered a new $15,000 request for the 300th anniversary committee, capital projects, an assessors' budget increase, and stormwater utility planning ahead of town meeting.

public_comment.topic: Thanked a departing commissioner, appealed for volunteers to fill a parks commission vacancy and the vacant recreation director position, and reported the Marshall Park project is paused while the skate park project moves toward the next phase.

votes.motion: Enter executive session under MGL c.30 sec.21A(3) to discuss collective bargaining strategy with Lunenburg Professional Firefighters Local 5369 (amended to reconvene in open session afterward)
votes.outcome: roll call, all members responded affirmatively

votes.motion: Approve a 30% rate increase for all rates under the Fitchburg-Lunenburg water intermunicipal agreement, effective per the schedule adopted by Fitchburg City Council April 18, 2023, with rates effective February 1, 2026
Approve the minutes of May 8, 2024 and May 14, 2024

budget_items.what_was_said: An original $5,000 seed allocation for the 300th anniversary committee went unspent in FY24 and lapsed into free cash; the committee now wants a new multi-year appropriation of $15,000 plus a separate gift fund for sponsorships and merchandise sales.
The intermunicipal agreement with Fitchburg fixes Lunenburg's water rates at Fitchburg's rates plus 30%; the board voted to adopt the increase effective February 1, 2026.
An agenda item to appoint a payroll and benefits coordinator was added but the board was not prepared to act, so it was passed over.
A grant-funded literacy coach resigned and the school committee is not planning to fill the position.

Capital planning discussed track and turf field engineering (targeting summer 2027 construction if approved at town meeting), plus primary school playground/driveway design, Turkey Hill intercom/security cameras, safety film, and a maintenance garage heating project.
The principal assessor presented a budget described as roughly a 6 to 7% increase overall to the board of assessors.

budget_items.topic: Stormwater utility bylaw and fee structure
budget_items.what_was_said: The plan is to bring a bylaw establishing the stormwater utility framework -- with no fee or dollar figures -- to annual town meeting, with the fee structure to follow at a special town meeting; the DPW director's stormwater budget is to be presented to the finance committee February 5.

decisions.decision: Appointment of a payroll and benefits coordinator was passed over for the night rather than acted on.
Board will pursue a joint select board/school committee warrant article on Kids Kingdom custody transfer, largely reusing the special town meeting language.
Chair will establish a working group for the 925 Mass Ave RFP, with Amanda as the select board representative, targeting an April 1 RFP advertisement.
Board deferred approving the appointment policy tonight; members to review individually and bring modifications to the next meeting for possible final approval.
A member (Amanda) volunteered to draft a first revision of the special event license policy, based on the 2018 town counsel draft, for the next meeting.

what_happened.line: Select Board voted unanimously to raise water rates under the Fitchburg intermunicipal agreement, effective February 1, 2026 (the size of the increase as heard on the recording, not independently confirmed here).
The board entered executive session to discuss collective bargaining strategy with the firefighters' union, Local 5369, before returning to open session.
The board deferred its own draft appointment policy to a future meeting after a lengthy line-by-line review, and passed over appointing a payroll and benefits coordinator.
The board will sponsor a joint warrant article with the school committee to transfer custody of the Kids Kingdom property, reusing most of the prior special town meeting language.
The 300th anniversary committee asked for a new multi-year appropriation after its original seed funding lapsed unspent into free cash.

why_it_matters: Water bills for Lunenburg customers served under the Fitchburg agreement will change because of tonight's vote, since the agreement ties Lunenburg's rate to Fitchburg's plus a fixed markup.
The stalled appointment policy and the open payroll-coordinator hire bear on how the town fills its own staff positions going forward.
The Kids Kingdom transfer and the anniversary committee's funding request are among the items residents may see on an upcoming town meeting warrant.
watch_next: Next Select Board meeting: possible final approval of the appointment policy and a first draft of the special event license policy
Annual town meeting: warrant articles including the Kids Kingdom custody transfer, 300th anniversary committee funding, and the stormwater utility bylaw
